John buys blue ties at $40 each, spending $200, so the number of blue ties is \(200 \div 40 = 5\). He buys twice as many red ties, so \(2 \times 5 = 10\) red ties. Red ties cost 50% more than blue ties, so each red tie costs \(40 + 0.5 \times 40 = 60\) dollars. The total cost for red ties is \(10 \times 60 = 600\) dollars. Adding the $200 spent on blue ties gives a total of \(200 + 600 = 800\) dollars.

Answer: 800
